[SWS_CM_10458] Handling of an ServiceInterface that does not contain any events, methods, or fields
⌈
If a SomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment is de-
fined for a ServiceInterface that does not contain any events, methods, or fields and
a ProvidedServiceInstance is defined in the ServiceInstanceManifest that
points to the SomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment in the role serviceInterface
then:
• the
ServiceInterface
shall
be
offered
over
SOME/IP
as
defined
by
[SWS_CM_00203]
which
means
that
the
Endpoint
Option
shall
include
the IP-Address, Port Number and Protocol as defined by the Provided-
SomeipServiceInstance
• the Server shall not create a UDP/TCP socket and shall not bind any socket to
the configured server address
⌋
